# ha-upgrade-v2

v1 already exists at `~/.grok/ha-marketplace/plugins/ha-upgrade-v1` (`installed: false`). This skill is v2. Never write into v1. Never overwrite `~/.grok/skills/ha-upgrade/SKILL.md`.

## Snap = version folder

When the operator says guardate una snap que podamos recuperar si no nos gusta:

1. Pack this /learn run as a **new** plugin folder `ha-upgrade-v2` via:
   `python3 ~/.grok/skills/ha-upgrade/scripts/pack.py pack --run-dir <RUN>`
2. Never overwrite a prior version. Never reuse N.
3. Never delete originals. Never duplicate trees. Path-contract per snap (one folder = one snap).
4. Show plugin path, action count, `installed: false`. Stop.
5. Do not `grok plugin install`. Apply only with `--go`.

## Apply / rollback

```
python3 ~/.grok/skills/ha-upgrade/scripts/pack.py apply --version 2 --go
python3 ~/.grok/skills/ha-upgrade/scripts/pack.py rollback --version 2 --go
```

Without `--go`, HOLD.
